verdict.rationale: Column's API is documented in depth. It covers accounts, ACH, wires, real-time payments, checks, a unified transfers endpoint, webhooks, idempotency keys and mode-scoped API keys, plus a sandbox that mirrors production. A public OpenAPI spec is confirmed live by probe, an llms.txt file is published, and a community commenter calls the documentation 'excellent'. Missing for 10: official client SDKs (an engineer said customers use the raw HTTP API, though SDKs can be generated from the spec) and independent hands-on reports of agents actually driving the API.
